selection: MERRA-2 0.5 latitude x 0.625 longitude grid rectangles intersecting Marrakech–Safi; boundary cells can have centres outside region
history: 1995 supplies lag context; target months 1997–2025; training weather normals start 1996
scope: rainfall only; existing point rainfall/SPI artifacts unchanged
model: same 200-tree absolute-error RF, depth 3, leaf 5, seed 42; no tuning
forecast: next calendar month, issued preceding month day 25, simulated 5-day delay
warning: known benchmark, not blind; dates shared across cells; correlated cells are not independent weather events; no spatial holdout; cell-mean MAE is not error of region-average rainfall
elevation: NASA source elevation, not precise farm elevation
variants: controlled ablation of coordinates and elevation using same cells, years and weather inputs
